note: National figure. statutory-fixed: FSDKSH voluntary membership of the compulsory scheme (Law 10383/2011). FSDKSH page: 'Per sigurimet shendetesore vullnetare, baza e llogaritjes se kontributit eshte dyfishi i pages minimale', contribution rate 3.4 per cent. The Fund page says that for foreigners the residence-permit number serves as the health-insurance number. Voluntary members have a 6-month waiting period (FSDKSH publication 'Kush Paguan'). Not an income-based charge: the base is fixed at twice the minimum wage. Working: Base per person = 2 x 50,000 ALL = 100,000 ALL a month (50,000 ALL is the monthly minimum wage the Social Insurance Institute (ISSH) page uses for voluntary pension contributions). Contribution = 3.4% x 100,000 = 3,400 ALL a month a person. Couple = 2 x 3,400 = 6,800 ALL a month (81,600 ALL a year).

National figure. statutory-fixed: Egeszsegugyi szolgaltatasi jarulek (health service contribution, Tbj. 43-44.), a fixed HUF 12,300 per person per month in 2026 (HUF 410 per day for part months), paid to NAV by the 12th of the following month. It buys the TAJ number's right to publicly funded care. Who may pay: a 'belfoldi' person who has no other insurance basis. A third-country couple on temporary residence cannot pay it until they hold long-term (permanent) residence status. Until then the couple would need private cover or self-pay, and I found no published private tariff to price that. Working: HUF 12,300 x 2 people = HUF 24,600 per month (HUF 295,200 a year). 2025 amount was HUF 11,800 (NAV table, per search summary; not checked on the cached page).

National figure. statutory-fixed: NFZ voluntary health insurance (dobrowolne ubezpieczenie zdrowotne). Open to foreigners who hold a temporary residence permit, permanent residence permit or EU long-term resident permit, who have no insurance title elsewhere in the EU and are not insured as a family member (NFZ guide, 14 Sept 2023). Contribution is 9% of the declared monthly income, with a floor: not less than the average monthly wage in the enterprise sector for the previous quarter (GUS notice of 20 Oct 2026: PLN 9,386.28 for Q3 2026). For Oct-Dec 2026 the minimum contribution is PLN 844.77 a month. The spouse is registered as a family member (druk ZUS ZCNA) and the NFZ page says 'Nie wiaze sie to z dodatkowa skladka', so one contribution covers both people. Full access to publicly funded care, same as other insured people. Paid to ZUS by the 20th of the following month. Working: 9,386.28 x 9% = 844.77 PLN a month (NFZ's own sum). One contribution for the couple because the spouse is a family member. 844.77 PLN is the floor, reached if the declared income is at or below PLN 9,386.28 a month. The floor moves each quarter with the GUS enterprise-sector average wage (it was not PLN 844.77 earlier in 2026; earlier quarters were not retrieved).
